label: rare: input l at step 4-5 in sequences starting with i (too sparse)
explanation: Active on only 33 of 1M sequences (17 steps in dev). All activations fall in the original phase at t=4-5, never on the delimiter or in the copy phase. Most mass (~90%) is on input l, and most activations come from sequences whose first token is i, often with e or w two steps back. The best conjunction (original phase, input l, first token i, t in 4-5) has precision of only about 1% (dev F1 0.02, mass recall 0.84). The feature looks like a very specific, rarely triggered context detector, but there are too few examples to characterize it reliably.
